acceptance_met: All eight section-4 producer cells implemented exactly as the table defines: try_send+flush pipelined drive, 8-topic mixed-topics (8x2500x100B), 10x16B headers, flush-every-100, sequential linger-0, 1-partition idle; tests pin IDs, totals, modes, header geometry and regeneration.

Allocation counting reuses the KL09-04 tool (codec::census over codec::CountingAlloc; drive bookkeeping pre-reserved and record buffers moved, zero harness allocs in the common path); CPU/RSS from libc via measure.rs; core crate untouched (workspace-excluded).

Every run emits a result artifact with provenance, cell ID and repetition index; disposition failed on any server-side validation failure, broker/client count mismatch, unacknowledged record or timeout (send modes verify offsets, try_send modes reconcile broker-accepted counts).

cargo clippy --manifest-path benchmarks/runtime/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings (0 warnings, exit 0)
python3 scripts/benchmark-report.py <each of the 8 artifacts> --quiet --json (8/8 valid, 0 errors)

limits: Null-broker (loopback) tier only: numbers measure client-side headroom, never feed claims (Suite HOLD active; cells registered exploratory/feeds_claims=false).
Records are pregenerated before the measured phase; generation CPU/allocs are outside the census but the fixture lives in RSS during the run (baseline_rss_bytes reported for subtraction).
RSS peak/mean come from a 10ms sampler; sub-10ms spikes can be missed (ru_maxrss reported separately as the process-wide reference).
macOS reports frequency_mhz 0.0 (no sysctl source on Apple Silicon; documented gap) and thread_count 0 (Linux-only /proc read).
try_send-mode latency is the offer-to-flush-complete bound per record, not a per-RPC RTT; flush-heavy flush time is additionally reported in flush_us_total.
QueueFull retries (~24/cell, initial metadata wait) each regenerate one record inside the census; counted in execution.queue_full_retries.

measurements.host: darwin arm64, release build, loopback nb-serve, 1 repetition per cell (section-4-aligned try_send+flush drive)
